references.text: The prophecy that the Messiah will come from Bethlehem in Judea, which is the geographical opposite of Galilee mentioned in John 7:41.
Philip confirms that Jesus is the one about whom Moses and the prophets wrote, but Nathanael raises the same doubt about whether the Messiah can come from Nazareth in Galilee.
Nicodemus is met with the same dismissive argument that no prophet comes from Galilee, which underscores the geographical prejudice in verse 41.
